scene: Inferno VII, fifth circle — Styx: the wrathful above, the sullen below
source: Dante Inferno VII near the closing verses; Styx, bubbles, submerged voices and the distant tower
story: Dante and Virgil follow the dark water down to the marsh called Styx
Wrathful souls above the water strike, kick and bite each other
Virgil points out that sullen souls are submerged beneath the mud
The submerged spirits sigh; bubbles reveal their presence but their words cannot be clearly spoken
Dante and Virgil continue around the marsh toward a tower

designRule.format: Each observed role must have a semantic description AND somatic action; action must be operationally specified, not just a label.
designRule.parity: odd element indices have toroids (); even indices have boxes []
designRule.identityPolicy: A behavior or location is not automatically a chemical element; keep number assignments separate from action descriptions.
